changelog:
本次版本修了亿个 Bug，完善了主动消息，并且添加了许多智慧功能，让 AI 更加智能，且兼容了各种文档的修改。

增添：
1. 二维码生成、图片处理与批量文件处理
2. Word / PPT / Excel 读写与文档格式互转
3. 代码静态检查、数据格式互通与文本对比
4. 酒馆模式快捷开关，减少角色卡拦截
5. 聊天内直接显示图片
6. 插件加密保护增强

修复了：
1. 卡片正则替换缺陷，前端卡片无法渲染
2. 世界书预算裁剪角色卡条目、记忆与对话关联丢失
3. 酒馆工具判断遗漏、记忆工具未隔离、提示词开销过大
4. 插件解密失效、证书校验公式不一致
5. 多处闪退：助手设置页、序列化、深度思考无法关闭、主题样式无法重置
6. 主动消息清空聊天记录与记忆、定时失效、设置不生效、发送到错误对话
7. 对话归属被改写、聊天记录被截断、附件被误删、删除消息静默失效
8. 全局圆角过大、弹窗选项渲染成一排独立大圆钮

────────────

This release fixes a huge number of bugs, improves proactive messaging, and adds many smart features that make the AI far more capable. It also improves compatibility with editing of various document formats.

Added:
1. QR code generation, image processing, and batch file handling
2. Word / PPT / Excel read-write and document format conversion
3. Code static analysis, data interoperability, and text diff
4. Tavern mode quick toggle to reduce card filtering
5. Images shown inline in chat
6. Stronger plugin encryption

Fixed:
1. Card regex replacement defects broke front-end cards
2. World book budgeting trimmed card entries; memories lost their link to conversations
3. Missing tavern tool branching; memory tools not isolated; excessive prompt overhead
4. Plugin decryption failed; inconsistent certificate validation
5. Several crashes: assistant settings, serialization, deep thinking toggle, theme reset
6. Proactive messaging could erase history and memories; scheduling failed; settings had no effect; wrong conversation targeted
7. Conversations reassigned to the wrong assistant; history silently truncated; attachments deleted by mistake; message deletion silently failed
8. Oversized corner radii; dialog options rendered as separate large pills
